purpose: Page-by-page review of the Saturn and Uranus moon deep-dives alongside the earlier asteroid-belt and Jupiter-moons deep-dives.

included.assets: Standard runtime art for pages 10, 12, 14 and 16; shared space-friend art; and narration clips whose filenames belong to those four pages. No high-quality tier exists in this source checkout.

selection: Every copied source file was confirmed in the output of scripts/ship-list.py solar-storybook. Private source art, Markdown, QC harnesses, tools, data files and Moon Explorer files were excluded.
art: The ten new deep-dive images were generated with OpenAI image generation on 2026-09-12 and encoded by solar-storybook/tools/build-runtime-assets.py; detailed prompts and source records remain private in the source app. Existing page art is reused where the review note says so.
